definitions: To remember and emphasize the religious meaning of Christmas.
To focus on the birth of Jesus Christ as the central reason for celebrating Christmas, rather than commercialism or secular aspects.
examples: Many people believe it's important to keep Christ in Christmas.
The sermon encouraged everyone to keep Christ in Christmas this holiday season.
For some, decorating is secondary to keeping Christ in Christmas.
synonyms: remember the reason for the season
focus on the true meaning of Christmas
